question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

PRAISE : RPIAES :: ACTIVE : CAITEV :: LOVELY : ?
solution:
The positional value table is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

 
• In PRAISE : RPIAES 

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d499a9faf23457cf4073c7e94923d024a2e065ed421f9908f7c6ed2e2ff41e1.png] .​​​ 
 
 

 

 
• In ACTIVE : CAITEV ​

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db31857a0862d99faded47d25f4a6803d836dc2ed886fbc73dc891117fb07e12.png] 
 
 

 

 
• Similarly, In **LOVELY : ?** ​

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93fdbb88212e1a6aad084a218afe684df03360804d9b2011df333acc556e099f.png] 
 
 

We get 'OLEVYL'.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
